name: Crescent City & Del Norte

map.locality_method: Draft discovery footprint for Del Norte. No fishing target, season status or route is published until native bottom, legal and forecast sources pass regional review. Geographic discovery extents are not legal boundaries.

harbor.name: Crescent City Harbor
harbor.entrance_note: Harbor and bar access require current local clearance; historical harbor surveys describe shoaling and uncharted approach rocks.

stations.tide_note: Crescent City station predicts water level, not the harbor entrance current, bottom drift or safe bar crossing.
stations.offshore_buoy_note: Outside the region; do not present as an observation of Del Norte fishing grounds.

bathymetry.reason: NOAA H11985 has local fine-depth grids outside MPAs, but original USGS camera windows corroborate no hard bottom well inside them; its chart hazards and substrate remain unqualified. All local H12131 fine grids touch Pyramid Point SMCA. F00562 harbor/approach is held; H11981 lies south. No local reef target is qualified.
